module "S_ReorderIsAppend.dss"

  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="y") : float @L8:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %2 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="x") : float @L8:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %3 = Append(%1, %2) : float2 @L8:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0)) : float @L8:C36 "EmissiveColor"
  %5 = Append(%3, %4) : float3 @L8:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %6 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%5) @L6:C1
  sink %6
